name: BlendMethod
brief: Blend method for compositing paint layers.
description: Defines various blending modes for combining a source paint (top layer) with a destination (bottom layer). Notation: S = source paint, D = destination, Sa = source alpha, Da = destination alpha.

members.name: Normal
members.brief: Perform alpha blending (default). S if (Sa == 255), otherwise (Sa * S) + (255 - Sa) * D

members.name: Multiply
members.brief: Multiply the RGB values of each pixel. (S * D)

members.name: Screen
members.brief: Invert, multiply, and invert again. (S + D) - (S * D)

members.name: Overlay
members.brief: Combines Multiply and Screen modes. (2 * S * D) if (D < 128), otherwise 255 - 2 * (255 - S) * (255 - D)

members.name: Darken
members.brief: Retains the smallest components. min(S, D)

members.name: Lighten
members.brief: Retains the largest components. max(S, D)

members.name: ColorDodge
members.brief: Divides the bottom layer by the inverted top layer. D / (255 - S)

members.name: ColorBurn
members.brief: Divides the inverted bottom layer by the top layer, then inverts. 255 - (255 - D) / S

members.name: HardLight
members.brief: Same as Overlay but with color roles reversed. (2 * S * D) if (S < 128), otherwise 255 - 2 * (255 - S) * (255 - D)

members.name: SoftLight
members.brief: Similar to Overlay but softer. (255 - 2 * S) * (D * D) + (2 * S * D)

members.name: Difference
members.brief: Absolute difference between layers. (S - D) if (S > D), otherwise (D - S)

members.name: Exclusion
members.brief: Twice the product subtracted from the sum. S + D - (2 * S * D)

members.name: Hue
members.brief: Combine with HSL(Sh + Ds + Dl) then convert to RGB

members.name: Saturation
members.brief: Combine with HSL(Dh + Ss + Dl) then convert to RGB

members.name: Color
members.brief: Combine with HSL(Sh + Ss + Dl) then convert to RGB

members.name: Luminosity
members.brief: Combine with HSL(Dh + Ds + Sl) then convert to RGB

members.name: Composition
members.brief: For intermediate composition layers; suitable for use with Scene or Picture
